### Day Thirty-six
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/whispers-of-hope-10-weeks-of-devotional-praye/whispers-of-hope-10-weeks-of-devotional-prayer-woh04-content-35.html
Passage: Hebrews 11:27
Points:
- Believers must anchor their faith in who God is rather than in what He does.
- Gauging faith by visible circumstances leads to emotional instability when God's ways are beyond our understanding.
- Because much of God's work is invisible, true faith cannot rely on outward observation.
- Like Moses enduring by looking to the invisible God, authentic faith focuses on seeking and knowing God Himself.
